PR90.body:
The native Count A extension currently requires its three original private files to be already owned by the runner. Restore the authenticated OWNER_BOOTSTRAP descriptor in the genuine metadata parent before offline inference, retain the original Root, and bind new paths to the actual source/run/job. The original model/corrector, 18-model catalog, output type and separate materialization/row budgets remain intact.

Preserve the existing source-history limit with the parent at 131070/131072 bytes and restore the exact DAD CLI predecessor pin under its existing identity gate. Original 315e/history/model commitments are unchanged. An existing test partition then exhausted its 960-second limit without a reported assertion failure. Frozen measured software-module costs now balance the same full test set across the same four whole-module partitions and unchanged deadlines. Independent coverage arithmetic confirms all 3087 original nodes plus four new CI checks, with no missing or duplicated execution.

Affected runtime/history checks, independent source review, 28 CI-planner checks and all 846 Main acceptance checks pass locally. Required remote CI is running for this final head.

Actual owner upload passed identity, authorization, qualification and canary controls, then received HTTP 401 at the first uploads.github.com metadata POST. Post-failure inventory confirms no Count A asset. The inherited connection credential owner must confirm/correct that authentication. No native inference, readable Count A feed, consumer admission or activation is claimed.
